notes: Codex CLI's current wire_api only supports "responses" (/v1/responses) -- "chat" was removed and errors on load (see codex-rs/model-provider-info). A plain openai-compat chat/completions server like ours has to go through the shared LiteLLM proxy, which bridges /v1/responses -> /v1/chat/completions (use_chat_completions_api: true). [model_providers.<id>].env_key references an env var name, never a literal key.
